title: Casper and the Safehouse
author: Rosalind Eastwick
blurb: Noor Thornbury, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
